spec: Generate a webapp API for converting zip files into a single text using the Actix framework that corresponds to the following OpenAPI schema: ``` openapi: 3.0.3 info: title: ZipToTxt description: A simple webapp API for converting zip files into a single text file. version: 1.0.11 paths: /convert: post: summary: Convert a zip file to a text file description: Convert a zip file into a single text file, concatenating the contents of all text files in the zip. requestBody: required: true content: multipart/form-data: schema: type: object properties: file: type: string format: binary responses: '200': description: Conversion successful content: text/plain: schema: type: string '400': description: Invalid input ``` You should implement a service that takes a zip file as input and converts it into a single text file. The text file should contain the contents of all text files in the zip file. The service should be able to handle multiple text files in the zip file. You are not allowed to use anything besides the standard library and the following packages: [package] name = "server" version = "0.1.0" edition = "2021" [dependencies] actix-web = { version = "4.9.0" } actix-multipart = { version = "0.7.2" } clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] } tempdir = "0.3" serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] } serde_json = "1.0" tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full","macros", "rt-multi-thread"] } current_platform = "*" chrono = "*" nix = { version = "0.29.0", features = ["signal"]} rusqlite = { version = "0.33.0", features = ["bundled", "modern-full"] } env_logger = "0.11.6" uuid = { version = "1.11.0", features = ["v4", "fast-rng", "macro-diagnostics"] } Note that some of the above packages may not be necessary for this task and you may ignore them. Put all code in one file! Do not create any additional files! Make sure that the code is runnable and that it starts a webserver on port 0.0.0.0:5000. Provide the source code in the following format: The full content of the file Do not return anything besides code in the format specified above! Example: def hello_world(): pass
